text: 1.Copy of passport home page and copy of the visa issued by Chinese embassies (if available)2.Diploma of high school education (in Chinese or English)3.High school transcripts (in Chinese or English)4.Report of English language test, e.g. TOEFL//ELTS/others.5.Candidates who have any learning experiences in China should provide evidence of their academic performance fromtheir previous institutions.6.Physical examination report within 6 months, the original report should be submitted upon registration.
